GeneDef.label: high nahn (1st-3rd)
GeneDef.description: A sergeant, master craftsman, or successful merchant. The highest station a darkeyes can achieve through merit alone. Respected by peers and grudgingly acknowledged by lighteyes.

GeneDef.label: mid nahn (4th-7th)
GeneDef.description: A common worker, soldier, or tradesman. The bulk of darkeyed society. Neither privileged nor destitute, simply enduring.

GeneDef.label: low nahn (8th-10th)
GeneDef.description: A tenner. The lowest rung. Servants, laborers for hire, those with nothing but their hands and their willingness to use them. What the caste system takes in dignity, it repays in callouses.
